acquisition_method: The variable window data in-dependent acquisition (DIA) method is described by Bruderer et al.
alkylation_concentration: alkylated with 25 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min
alkylation_reagent: alkylated with 25 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min
cleavage_agent: Proteins were digested by incubation with trypsin (1/100, w/w, Sequencing Grade Modified Trypsin, Porcine; Promega) for at least 9 h at 37 °C.
fractionation_method: Mouse peptide samples (plasma, spleen, kidney, liver, leukocytes, and heart) from the time-course experiment were pooled per sample type and time points (0 h together with 6 h and 12 h together with 18 h) and then fractionated with High pH Reversed-Phase (Pierce) into a total of 96 samples.
fragmentation_method: with a stepped normalized collision energy (NCE) of 25.5, 27 and 30
instrument: Peptide analyses (corresponding to 1 µg protein) were performed on a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) connected to an EASY-nLC 1200 ultra-HPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization_type: Peptide analyses (corresponding to 1 µg protein) were performed on a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) connected to an EASY-nLC 1200 ultra-HPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: inferred: No isobaric or metabolic labeling strategy was mentioned in the sample preparation or MS analysis sections; the study relies on DIA quantification using PROCAL standards for library generation but analyzes biological samples without covalent or metabolic labels.
mass_analyzer: inferred: The instrument identified is a Q Exactive HF-X, which contains an Orbitrap mass analyzer.
reduction_concentration: reduced with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride, pH 7.0, for 45 min at 37 °C
reduction_reagent: reduced with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride, pH 7.0, for 45 min at 37 °C
